tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Accommodation SEARCH tool for Italy (read-only). Call this tool ONLY when the user is explicitly looking for places to stay / availability / listings. DO NOT call for booking, payment, reservation confirmation, cancellation, customer support, itineraries, attractions, restaurants, or general travel advice.

checkin.description: Date in ISO format for checkin

checkout.description: Date in ISO format for checkout and must be greater than checkin date

adults.description: Number of adult people over 18 years old (default: 2).

rooms.description: Number of rooms in which distribute the people (default: 1).

filters.description: Optional list of search filter ids. Use exact ids only. Meanings: PrenotazioneDiretta: direct or instant booking available; CancellazioneGratuita: free cancellation available; Topbnb: TopBnB properties with strong booking experience; BagnoPrivato: private bathroom; AnimaliAmmessi: pets allowed; Parcheggio: parking available; Climatizzazione: air conditioning; AccessoDisabili: accessible for guests with disabilities; SmokeFriendly: smoking-friendly property or rooms; Piscina: swimming pool; Giardino: garden; Televisione: television; Wifi: Wi-Fi internet access; Phon: hair dryer; Riscaldamento: heating; Camino: fireplace; ColazioneAbbondante: abundant breakfast; FattoriaConAnimali: farm with animals; FattoriaDidattica: educational farm; AngoloCottura: kitchenette; HomeRestaurant: home restaurant; Ristorante: restaurant; Trekking: suitable for trekking or hiking; PisteCiclabili: suitable for cycling or cycle tourism; BicicletteDisponibili: bicycles available; Spa: spa facilities; Sauna: sauna; VascaIdromassaggio: hot tub or whirlpool bath; PalestraGym: gym or fitness room; DimoraPrestigio: prestigious property; CharmeDesign: charming or design property; Nuovissimo: new or recently renovated property; Economico: budget-friendly property; Famiglie: suitable for families; PerAffari: suitable for business travel; FugaRomantica: suitable for a romantic getaway; InCentro: central location; InRivaAlMare: seafront or near the sea; VicinoStazione: near a train station; InZonaShopping: near a shopping area; PanoramaSpettacolare: spectacular view; strutture_tutte: all accommodation types; default property-type filter; Maneggio: horse riding facilities or nearby riding stable.
